review.reason: The P1.F2 hunks show bounded capability improvements: adding cached-result-dependent chart settings and switching the default output tab. This could improve UX and reduce redundant rendering, but lacks evidence of wider adoption, incident prevention, or cross-component dependency handling. Tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration not present here.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog users who use SQL notebooks with warehouse connections; may help them see visualizations faster when results are already available.
review.uncertainty: Snapshot-only hunk does not establish test compatibility or regression behavior. No release notes or WPR provided. Grouping relies on shared notebook context without explicit dependency markers.
